# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

## 1. Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $80–$109)
This is WIRED's top pick after testing more than 30 models. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Design:** A chrome "tree" holds the iPhone and Watch in the air, with an AirPods spot on the base. The iPhone pad tilts, and it works in landscape for StandBy mode.
- **Charging:** Up to 15 W for the iPhone, plus fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 or newer.
- **In the box:** A 36 W power adapter. It has a 2-year warranty.
- **Price:** $109 list. WIRED saw it for $98 from Belkin, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- **Where to buy:** Use the shop links on WIRED's page: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Who it's for:** Most people charging overnight. WIRED notes that 25 W "makes little difference if you charge your devices overnight."

## 2. Fastest premium stand: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)
- **Charging:** Qi2 25 W for the iPhone and fast charging for the Apple Watch.
- **Design:** A heavy glossy black base, so you can lift your phone off with one hand without the stand tipping.
- **Catch:** No power adapter is included. You need one rated at 40 W, and WIRED suggests Nomad's $25 40W Slim Adapter.

Source: [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## 3. Best value: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (about $40)
- **Price:** $80 list, seen at $40 on Amazon. WIRED calls it "by far the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1."
- **Charging:** 15 W for the iPhone.
- **Design:** Compact. The Apple Watch puck detaches so you can travel with it.
- **In the box:** A 33 W adapter and cable.

Source: [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## 4. If you want 25 W and travel use: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25 W ($99.99)
- **Charging:** 25 W, but only on the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20 W, and older iPhones get 15 W.
- **Cooling:** It has a cooling fan that you can switch off at night.
- **In the box:** A 50 W adapter.
- **Design:** It's a lightweight plastic foldable that sits fairly low, lifting the phone about 20 mm. Folded, it's about 110 × 62 × 19.5 mm.

Sources: [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Discount code:** Dealectric reports that code **PARTNER18** took $17.99 off at ESR's US store when it tested the cart on Oct 23, 2026, bringing the price to about $82. The code expires 12/31/2026. Their link is an affiliate link, so they earn a commission if you buy through it: https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand ([details](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand))

**Caveat:** WIRED says the 25 W version is "far more expensive for very little gain" compared with ESR's $40 model.

## Also worth a look
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25 W ($129.99):** The tallest and most adjustable foldable, lifting the phone more than 70 mm. It includes a 45 W adapter and UK/EU plugs. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **Nimble Podium ($130):** A flat pad design if you'd rather not see screens at night. It supports 25 W for the iPhone, but Watch charging is slow. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

## Quick pick
- **Nightstand charging:** The Belkin, or the ESR at $40 if you're on a budget.
- **You want 25 W and own a compatible iPhone 16 or 17:** The Nomad Stand One Max for home, or the ESR CryoBoost or Satechi if you also travel.

Prices change often, so check the retailer before buying.
